item.title: The Program Redesign the IMF Needs
item.description: The International Monetary Fund’s guidelines for program design are more salient than ever, given widespread debt distress in developing countries. As the Fund undertakes its first major evaluation since 2019, it should focus on three features of its lending, all of which need to be reformed.
